newsitem.title: CANADA: Gold Reserve rises on recent news.
newsitem.headline: Gold Reserve rises on recent news.

text.p: Gold Reserve Corp soared in Toronto and on Nasdaq on Friday after a series of positive news releases this week.
Shares in the gold company rose 3.40 to 17.40 on more than 800,000 shares in early trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. It was up 2-3/8 to 12-1/2 on Nasdaq.

The Spokane, Washington-based company said on Wednesday it was granted rights to the hard rock at its Brisas property in Venezuela. On Thursday, it said drilling results at its property struck extensive gold mineralization and increased the size of its deposit.
